eloise-the-bistro.blurb: Eloise Bistro & Boulangerie, a European-style bistro on Lake Terrace with elegant decor and French-leaning food.

tips.expect: A pretty, European-feeling bistro and bakery. Reported hours are noon to 11 pm, and it costs about ₹1,200 or more for two.
tips.good: The signature burrata caprese and the hot chocolate.
tips.watch: It is in the busy Lake Market cafe cluster, so weekends fill up.
tips.tip: Near Deshapriya Park and the Kalighat pandals, so easy to add to a south circuit.

desi-lane-esplanade.blurb: An outlet of the Desi Lane pub chain, which is known for very low-priced drinks.

tips.expect: A busy, no-frills pub and bar-food place. At the Topsia outlet, listings put it at about ₹1,700 for two.
tips.good: Cheap drinks and a lively crowd.
tips.watch: I couldn't confirm details for this exact Esplanade outlet, so prices and hours may differ.
tips.tip: A late-night option near Esplanade after pandal-hopping.

kaafila.blurb: A Mughlai, Afghan and North Indian restaurant in City Centre 1, Salt Lake.

tips.expect: A family-friendly restaurant with a long kebab, biryani and curry menu. About ₹1,800 for two.
tips.good: The kebabs, especially the Kandahari laham, and the dessert firni.
tips.watch: It is inside a mall, so closing time follows the mall.
tips.tip: Good for dinner after the Salt Lake pandals, as City Centre is on the way back.

mehico.blurb: A vibrant Mexican cantina on Ho Chi Minh Sarani, with murals and a menu of small plates.

tips.expect: A colourful cantina with small plates, tacos, nachos and rice bowls. Tacos are about ₹500 each.
tips.good: A seasonal mango menu, and a rare real Mexican option in Kolkata.
tips.watch: Prices add up quickly if you order several plates and drinks.
tips.tip: Combine with Cove and Sorano in the same building area for a Park Street night.

bonne-femme.blurb: A bakery and continental restaurant at 139A Rash Behari Avenue, in a 46-seat teal room that feels like an old Calcutta bungalow.

tips.expect: Fusion plates with a Bengali twist, in a cosy, small room. About ₹1,500 for two.
tips.good: The Bengali-flavoured continental dishes, such as gondhoraj stroganoff and daab sandesh.
tips.watch: Only 46 seats, so book ahead on Puja weekends.
tips.tip: Close to Hindustan Park and the Ballygunge pandals.

sorano.blurb: An Italian restaurant in the old Harrington Mansion, off Park Street, making almost everything in-house.
dishes: Brick-oven pizza and bread from a 150-year-old Tuscan sourdough starter

tips.expect: A serious Italian kitchen in a heritage building. About ₹2,400 for two.
tips.good: The sourdough-based pizza and the house-made cheeses and pasta.
tips.watch: It sits towards the high end for the area.
tips.tip: A good date-night dinner. Pair it with Mehico and Cove nearby.

balwant-singh-dhaba.blurb: Balwant Singh's Eating House at 10B Harish Mukherjee Road, a Bhowanipore dhaba with more than a century behind it, reportedly open 24 hours.

tips.expect: An unpretentious, fully vegetarian Punjabi dhaba that serves from early morning to the middle of the night. About ₹500 for two.
tips.good: The kettle chai, the doodh cola and the Amritsari kulcha.
tips.watch: It is basic and can be crowded at peak times.
tips.tip: The best late-night or very-early-morning stop after pandal-hopping in the south.
